description: The pilot and first television shorts establish Pat and Mat's basic world: ordinary domestic problems around food, decorating, furniture, the garage and lighting become excuses for increasingly elaborate acts of practical improvisation.

s01e00.description: Pat and Mat try to roast a chicken, but preparing a simple meal becomes a chain of improvised cooking methods and collateral damage.

s01e01.description: A splattered lunch leaves the room needing new wallpaper, and the pair turn decorating into a struggle with paste, paper and their own increasingly elaborate fixes.

s01e02.description: With books overflowing everywhere, Mat decides to build proper shelving. The project escalates as Pat joins in and the tools needed for the job become almost more important than the books.

s01e03.description: A dirty carpet seems to need nothing more than a good cleaning, until every attempt to move, beat and restore it creates a fresh problem for Pat and Mat to solve.

s01e04.description: After repeated tumbles from an ordinary chair while watching television, Pat and Mat decide to build a proper rocking chair, then engineer an increasingly complicated way to make it rock.

s01e05.description: A large framed picture refuses to fit through the doorway, so Pat and Mat begin taking the frame and canvas apart and discover that putting art back together is much harder than dismantling it.

s01e06.description: Pat and Mat have both a car and a garage, yet getting one neatly inside the other becomes a destructive exercise in measuring, maneuvering and mechanical improvisation.

s01e07.description: A failed light bulb interrupts a chess game, sending Pat and Mat into a deceptively difficult repair job where reaching and replacing the light becomes the real contest.
